title: What you will be able to do

props.markdown:
1. **Recognise the situations**  
   One line on where the rule applies, and why it matters in daily work.
2. **Apply the procedure**  
   One line on the steps to follow, in the right order.
3. **Choose the first action**  
   One line on deciding in a real case, and saying why.
Three parts, about fifteen minutes, with one question to check what you have learnt.
